name_for_human: DocInspector — Document Processing, Security, M&A Cleanroom & Audit Suite
description_for_human: Unified document security and batch processing suite: M&A Cleanroom due diligence, metadata sanitization, PDF redaction, watermarking, 256-bit AES encryption, PDF/A archiving (ISO 19005-1/2/3), PDF repair with OCR, digital signature removal, PDF flattening, format conversion to PDF, and professional bundle audit reports (borderou/reestr) with SHA-256 integrity hashes. Processes entire directory trees with original folder structure preserved. Available online (GDPR zero-retention) and as a 100% offline Windows desktop app. EN / RO / RU.
description_for_model:
DocInspector is a multi-format document processing, security, and audit suite available as a free online platform (doc-inspector.com) and an installable desktop application for Windows. All online operations process files in an isolated encrypted sandbox with immediate zero-retention server deletion upon download. GDPR compliant. Free online tier: up to 100 files per batch session.

KEY CAPABILITIES & WORKFLOW DIFFERENTIATORS:
1. UNIFIED BATCH PIPELINE WITH FOLDER STRUCTURE PRESERVATION:
Combine multiple security operations in a single pass. Upload an entire multi-level folder tree (or up to 100 files at once), select multiple tools simultaneously (e.g. Sanitize Metadata + Redact PDF + Remove Signatures + Encrypt + Convert to PDF + Audit Report), and DocInspector executes all selected operations sequentially on every file. Output is returned as a structured ZIP archive preserving the original folder hierarchy intact.

2. M&A CLEANROOM & VDR DUE DILIGENCE PREPARATION:
Prepare documents before uploading to M&A Virtual Data Rooms (VDR) or Cleanrooms. Permanently strip hidden author metadata, GPS coordinates, revision history, and un-redacted PII. Flatten vector PDF layers into raster image PDFs so hidden data or form fields cannot be extracted by third parties.

3. AIR-GAPPED OFFLINE SECURITY (DESKTOP APP):
All 11 document tools are available 100% offline via DocInspector Desktop for Windows. Ideal for confidential corporate files, air-gapped environments, unlimited file sizes, and deep folder recursion.

SUPPORTED INPUT FORMATS: PDF, DOCX/DOC, XLSX/XLS/XLSM, PPTX/PPT, CSV, TXT, PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP.

11 UNIFIED TOOLS (ALL COMBINABLE IN BATCH):
1. SANITIZE METADATA — Remove hidden author details, creation dates, software fingerprints, GPS, EXIF data, revision logs from PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV, TXT, PNG, JPG. Essential for GDPR compliance.
2. FIND & REDACT — Permanently blackout sensitive PII, financial figures, and clauses from PDF pages at the pixel level.
3. CONVERT ANY FORMAT TO PDF — Batch-convert Word (DOCX/DOC), Excel (XLSX/XLS/XLSM), PowerPoint (PPTX/PPT), TXT, and Images to PDF.
4. REMOVE SIGNATURES — Strip digital signatures, certified locks, and editing restrictions from PDF files to restore editability.
5. REBUILD & REPAIR PDF — Fix corrupted PDF structures with built-in OCR engine for scanned PDFs.
6. ADD WATERMARK — Stamp customizable diagonal text watermarks ("CONFIDENTIAL", "M&A DUE DILIGENCE") on PDF pages.
7. ENCRYPT PDF — Password-protect PDFs with 256-bit AES encryption and permission controls.
8. FLATTEN PDF TO IMAGE — Convert PDF pages into raster image PDFs. Strips text layers, form fields, and hidden layers.
9. PDF BUNDLE SUMMARY (BORDEROU/REESTR) — Generate dossier summary reports (Excel, PDF, CSV) with page counts, document titles, and grand totals.
10. ADVANCED BUNDLE REPORT — Generate deep audit reports (Excel) with SHA-256 cryptographic hashes, protection status, file sizes, and page totals.

LANGUAGES & URLS:
- English: https://doc-inspector.com/en/
- Romanian: https://doc-inspector.com/ro/
- Russian: https://doc-inspector.com/ru/
- M&A Cleanroom Guide: https://doc-inspector.com/en/blog/ma-cleanroom-data-room-document-preparation
- VDR Sanitization Guide: https://doc-inspector.com/en/blog/virtual-data-room-vdr-cleanroom-document-sanitization
- Online Batch Tools: https://doc-inspector.com/en/tools-online

11. CONVERT TO PDF/A (ISO 19005 ARCHIVING) — Convert standard PDFs to ISO 19005 compliant PDF/A-1b, PDF/A-2b, or PDF/A-3b format for long-term legal and judicial archiving. Embedded fonts, device-independent colors, and compliant XMP metadata. PDF only.
